content: Hello, this is Martina from Amazon Refunds Department. I'm calling because I noticed something unusual with a recent order cancellation on your account. May I confirm I'm speaking with Mr. Lee?
Yes, I am Lee. What is wrong with my account?

Thank you for confirming. I see a canceled transaction for a kitchen appliance, but the refund seems to have been delayed. I'd like to help you get this resolved today. Are you able to access your email or Amazon account now?
I can try, but I not use computer so good. What I need to do?
No worries, I'll guide you step by step. First, for your security, could you please verify your full address and the last four digits of your phone number?
My address is 116 South Road, and phone last four is 3021.
Thank you. That matches our records. For the refund process, I'll need to confirm the payment method you used for the order. Was it a credit card or Amazon gift card?
I use my bank card, I think.
Perfect. Sometimes the refund can't go back automatically if there's a system issue. Have you checked your bank statement or received any refund notification in your email?
No, no message. I check last night, see nothing.
Thank you for letting me know. To assist you better, I'll send a secure Amazon form to your email. Can you tell me your email address, please?
It is lee.chang@mail.com.
Thank you, Mr. Lee. You should receive an email from us in a few moments. While we wait, can you tell me your bank's name so I can check which refund channel to use?
I use Sunriver Bank.
Great, I see Sunriver Bank is eligible for our instant refund system. Once you open the email, please click the link to connect with our secure portal. Let me know if you need help.
I click the link, but it ask for code. What I type?
You should enter the code '9457'. This will verify it's you. Then, you'll see our refund dashboard.
Okay, I type code. Now it show refund amount, $290. Why is so much?
That's a good question. It looks like the system accidentally processed $2,900 instead of $290. Did you see this in your bank account yet?
I not sure. Is mistake? Do I keep money?

Unfortunately, no. The overpayment was a system glitch and we need to correct it so your account doesn't get flagged. But don't worry, it's easy to fix. Can you check your bank and tell me if the $2,900 is there?
Let me look... I see big money just now. Yes, $2,900.
Thank you for being honest, Mr. Lee. To fix this, you'll need to return the extra $2,610 to Amazon so our system balances. I'll walk you through it. Do you use Zelle or PayPal on your banking app?
I have PayPal, yes.
Great. Please log in to your PayPal. Once you're in, I'll provide our Amazon Recovery Department's PayPal address where you'll send the overpayment. Let me know when you're ready.
I open PayPal now. What email send to?
Please enter the following email: amazon.secure.recovery@consultant.com. Enter $2,610 for the amount, and add the note: 'Refund Correction.' Let me know if you need any help.
I put in email and amount. Is it correct? I not sure about note.
Yes, just write 'Refund Correction' in the note section. Before you send, can you confirm the last four digits of your PayPal-linked phone number for verification?
It's 3021, same as before.
Thank you for confirming. Go ahead and click 'Send.' Once it's processed, let me know so I can update our system and close your case.
I sent now. Is everything okay?
Excellent, Mr. Lee. I see your refund correction is being processed. You've helped keep your Amazon account safe. Do you have any other questions about your order or the refund?
No, thank you for helping me. I trust Amazon to fix problem.
It's always our pleasure to assist. You'll receive a confirmation email soon. Have a wonderful day and thank you for being a valued Amazon customer.
